💔 I was twenty minutes late to my daughter's birthday, carrying her present.
My husband of twenty seven years saw me first. His new wife was sitting right beside him.
He looked at me, laughed, and said, out loud, for the whole table to hear:

His new wife touched his arm and said his name. He said, "What? Look at her."

Fourteen people heard it. Not one of them said a word.
I put the present down on the table, and I walked back out the way I came. 💔
My daughter caught me on the driveway. "Dad was out of line, Mom."
I said, "Fourteen people heard it, sweetheart. And nobody said anything."
Then she said the thing that started all of this: "My engagement party is in ten weeks. Same yard. Same table. Dad too. Please come. And please be okay."
The weeks after that were their own kind of quiet 👇🏾
A cashier added the senior discount to my groceries without asking. Sixty five and over. I am fifty six.
A young mother pulled her little boy's stroller around me and told him, "That lady is not feeling well, baby. Eyes forward."
A woman who had lived one floor below me for a year still did not know my name.
I had already spent a fortune trying to fix it. A four hundred dollar serum. Eleven creams underneath it. Every single one just sat on top of my face and left me looking more worn out than before. 😔
So I did the only thing I knew how to do. I walked every morning and I ate less. Two weeks of it took eight pounds off me. And the face in the oven door had not moved an inch.
Then I sat in my friend Denise's kitchen. She is eleven years older than me and looks younger than me. I asked her, straight, how.
She said 👇🏾
❌ None of it is made for our skin, Gloria. It is built for lighter skin that ages at the surface. So on us it just sits on top and does nothing, because the part that is actually going is underneath. The jaw.…
